item.title: Navigating Big Data: Real-Time Data Warehousing Practices and Governance Solutions
item.description: This article explores the challenges and solutions associated with real-time data warehousing in the context of big data. It discusses best practices for managing data warehousing processes, the importance of governance in ensuring data quality and compliance, and highlights innovative technologies that facilitate real-time data analytics.
